reason: I tried vidIQ and it didn't help, and I've never paid for a creator tool. Ten free credits a month is enough to poke at it, but I'm not paying until it shows me something YouTube Studio doesn't already show me.
objection: Will it tell me why a video flopped in a way I can act on, or just rephrase my analytics with AI language? And why should I give it read access to my channel?
would_change_my_mind: If it named a specific, checkable reason one of my videos underperformed, and my next upload using its advice clearly beat my usual views.
